_doc: Learned vanilla-metatile -> snowy-bern-metatile reskin map (from Nicolas hand-retiles). Applied by gen_map_editor as the starting reskin so future chapters inherit his conventions. Target indices are snowy-bern metatiles: gen_map_editor applies this ONLY when --tileset matches `tileset` below (a cave-interior reskin, e.g. ch03, must not inherit snowy-bern indices). Keys are VANILLA metatile ids, which only mean something within one vanilla tileset; `source_tileset` names it. Every reskin through ch06 rode TileConfiguration1, so gen_map_editor skips this map when the layout rides another (Ch5Map rides TileConfiguration2).
